provenance.attribution: Original synthetic name elements and tables authored for lexiconlang. No real living people, trademarks, copyrighted settings or third-party corpora used. Name elements are inspired by broadly public-domain linguistic families (Latin, Old English, Celtic, Norse) but are not reconstructions of any specific historical record.
